resumen: Push-ups with the hands together under the chest. The elbow travels further, and the triceps pays for that extra range.
ejecucion: Get into a push-up position with your hands together under your chest.
Index fingers and thumbs almost touch, forming a triangle.
Lower until your chest brushes your hands, elbows close to your body.
Press up by straightening the elbows without the hips sagging or rising.
If you cannot manage them yet, do them with your hands raised on a bench.
matices: In the cited work, in diamond push-ups the triceps was activated significantly more than the pectoralis, the opposite of standard and wide push-ups. Pectoralis activation, on the other hand, barely changed from the normal version: you gain triceps without losing chest.
